parent: arena-v1.4-r1; native guarded eval, frozen weights, v14 and v14hold p50band
screen: 1536 consecutive natural games. Seed 85100000+i, assigned turn 7+i%5. First parent purchase in that turn having an affordable distinct alternative. Log every missed opportunity. Compare original vs highest prior other card for one action only, then parent until terminal. Independent games across sources and shared seed within each pair.
fit: First 1024 source games v14. Fit standardized ridge multi-output regression with fixed L2 penalty 32. Predict the paired alternative-minus-parent outcomes and raw terminal utility. Compare contextual offer effects to state-only ridge on turn, HP, gold and log board. Fit before transfer inspection. Rich features use only public card text mechanics, shop, board and parent prior, no card IDs.
endpoints: Outcomes in source turn and next: generated physical cards deployed, excess uses beyond first per generator type, non-sale gold verifiably spent again within turn, number of full-board actions, EOT next-turn HP and log(1+total stats) (zero for missing EOT), raw rank utility. There is no reward shaping or action supervision.
transfer: 512 separate v14hold games. For economic prediction compare mean standardized squared error over the first six outcomes. Extra leave-mechanical-majority-out fit probes board-family generalization. For original utility choose alternative only for positive forecast, compare to parent at all 512 games incl unavailable states as zero. Bootstrap paired independent source games. No reuse of transfer as training data. Shortlist only with positive lower 95% bound for utility and reduced held-out prediction error; confirm natural repeats before formal training.
